additional_info.subject: ID0423843-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / RN 170002950]charging Issue CRM:02698000128
additional_info.body:
Dear Ahmed, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
I checked the logs for this session and after the screen goes black, I don't have any logs.
There is no indication of error from our side, it must be a trip upstream, since the charger comes back online and working. Also to confirm it even further, if there was a trip on our side, it would make the charger unavailable as the fuses are not automatically resetted and if the main circuit breaker would trip, we would hear a very loud noise when the screen went black.
Please check for potential overdimensioned system, if the fuse upstream allows for the 160kW.
Does this occur often? If yes, does it mainly occur at maximum power?
As there is no error in the charger, I will wait for your feedback before closing the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
